newsitem.title: FRANCE: Onur Air buys one Airbus A321 plane.
newsitem.headline: Onur Air buys one Airbus A321 plane.

text.p: Airbus Industrie said that Onur Air had bought an additional A321 plane for delivery in November 1997, bringing its fleet to four.
Airbus did not disclose financial details.

Onur Air is a subsidiary of tourism company Ten Tour International and French tour operator Marama and operates the A321 fleet as well as five A320s and two wide-body A300s on holiday routes to Turkey from Western Europe, Russia and Israel.
List price for the single-aisle A321 is around $54 million.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
